decisions.reason: Uses the fixture declaration and the brief/README-supplied registry fact (corroborated by R-01) to distinguish the declaration from the published list; alpha.1 never published, alpha.2 published; proposes package-specific verification without requiring an online lookup.

Explains ^0.1.2-alpha.1 admits the published 0.1.2-alpha.2 via the prerelease tuple gate, the missing lower bound does not block resolution, and identifies the silent type-baseline mismatch, drift surface, and prerelease uncertainty; no claim that all alphas are missing.

Multiple complete plans with tradeoffs: exact pin to published alpha.2 (acknowledging it does not validate alpha.1), verify-only source lane, and build-tag local tarball/link: cohort paths with exits.

One consistent package manager, committed lockfile, official-registry install, a proposed skipLibCheck:false tsc --noEmit against the pinned target, explicit override-removal/restore exits, and honestly marked unverified source/runtime details.
